headline: Crude Oil Falls as Middle East Diplomacy Intensifies Before US and Israeli Votes
summary: Brent crude for December settlement declined 0.9% to $114.72 per barrel in Asian trading. The price drop followed increased diplomatic activity surrounding Iran ahead of key elections.
why: Brent crude is the international benchmark for global petroleum pricing, heavily influenced by Middle Eastern geopolitical risks.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Diplomatic talks surrounding Iran eased market fears of immediate crude supply disruptions.

why_moved: Oil prices slipped as diplomatic progress in the Middle East lowered supply disruption risks.
